data.gender_notes: Etz is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Genesis, the Tree of Knowledge is the name given to the tree in the Garden of Eden whose fruit, when eaten by Adam and Eve, brought them human knowledge and the awareness of good and evil. This name can be given to a child as a reminder of the importance of knowledge and the consequences of its misuse. The name Etz carries the meaning “Tree of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Etz usually hope their child will grow to embody tree of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the connection between the physical world and the spiritual realm. The tree of life is a powerful symbol in many religious and spiritual traditions, representing growth, renewal, and the interconnectedness of all things.
data.etymology: Etz belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tree of Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Etz total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם עץ הוא שם עברי שפירושו עץ, ומייצג חוזק ויציבות. הוא קשור למילה העברית 'עץ' שמתארת את הצמח החזק והיציב. בתנך, העץ הוא סמל לחיים, לחוזק ולשגשוג. השם עץ משמש גם כסמל להגנה ולמחסה.

in_greek.name: Έτσ
in_greek.meaning: Το Έτσ σημαίνει δέντρο ή ξύλο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Έτσ είναι μια ελληνική εκδοχή του εβραϊκού ονόματος עץ, που σημαίνει δέντρο ή ξύλο. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το δέντρο είναι σύμβολο ζωής, δύναμης και σταθερότητας. Το όνομα Έτσ μπορεί να σχετίζεται με την ελληνική λέξη 'ξύλο', που σημαίνει ξύλο ή δέντρο.
